SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8039
S.I. Special Branch / Shanghai
REPORT
Date August 16, 19 37
Subject Increase in prices of provisions and vegetables.
Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

An increase of 20% to 25% in the price of chicken,
pork, duck, beef and fish and an increase of 20% to 30% in the
price of vegetables, were registered on August 14 at the follow-
ing markets.

Peking Road Market, Nth. Fukien Road Market,
Furden Road Market, Foochow Road Market,
Shanhaikwan Road Market, Sinza Road Market,
Taku Road Market,

There are about 2000 to 3000 pigs in stock in the Settle-
ment. This supply is only sufficient to last for three or
four days. Dead meat in cold storage is estimated at 500 to
600 carcasses, enough for one week. No fresh fish has arrived
here for two days. Because of the scarcity of supplies, only
one half of the hawkers have appeared in the different markets.

Vegetables are coming in from Jessfield village in the
western district but no supplies have arrived from either Poo-
tung, Chapei or the surrounding country districts.

Vegetables sold in the French Concession arrive through
the South Railway Station and continue to do so.

Sec S.M.C.
(印：16 AUG 1937 SHANGHAI)
C. Crawford
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).
DBK
16/8.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 8039
S.I. 特别处 / 上海
报告
日期 1937年8月16日
事由 食品及蔬菜价格上涨。
制作及报送人 D. I. Crawford

8月14日，以下市场登记到鸡肉、猪肉、鸭肉、牛肉和鱼类的价格上涨20%至25%，蔬菜价格上涨20%至30%。

北京路市场，北福建路市场，
弗登路市场，福州路市场，
山海关路市场，新闸路市场，
大沽路市场，

租界内生猪库存约为2000至3000头。此供应量仅够维持三至四天。冷藏死肉估计有500至600具 carcasses（尸体/胴体），足够一周之用。已有两天未有鲜鱼运抵此地。由于物资短缺，各市场出现的摊贩仅有一半。

蔬菜正从西区极司菲尔（Jessfield）村运入，但浦东、闸北或周边乡村地区均无物资运抵。

法租界出售的蔬菜经由南站运入，且持续如此。

工部局秘书收悉
（印章：1937年8月16日 上海）
C. Crawford
D. I.（督察长）

D. C.（特别处）。
DBK
16/8.
